verses.saheeh: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
verses.khattab: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lo! We revealed it, that is, the Qur'an, in its entirety, [sending it down] from the Preserved Tablet to the heaven of this world, on the Night of Ordainment, that is, [the Night] of great eminence.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne is (Quran) ko shab-e-qadr mei nazil kiya hai

verses.saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
verses.khattab: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And what will show you, [what] will make known to you, O Muhammad (s), what the Night of Ordainment is? — [intended] to emphasise its great status and to provoke marvel at it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tum kya jano kay shab-e-qadr kya hai

verses.uthmani: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
verses.indopak: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ ۙ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ ۗ
verses.transliteration: laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin
verses.saheeh: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
verses.khattab: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The Night of Ordainment is better than a thousand months, in which there is no Night of Ordainment, for a righteous deed on that Night is better than one [performed] for a thousand months without it.
verses.romanUrdu: Shab-e-qadr hazar mahino se zyada behtar hai

verses.uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
verses.indopak: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةُ وَالرُّوْحُ فِيْهَا بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ مِّنْ كُلِّ اَمْرٍ ۛ
verses.transliteration: tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin
verses.saheeh: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
verses.khattab: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The angels and the Spirit, namely, Gabriel, descend (tanazzalu: one of the two original tā’ letters [of tatanazzalu] has been omitted) in it, on that night, by the leave of their Lord, by His command, with every command, that God has decreed from that year to the following one (min is causative functioning as bi, ‘with’).
verses.romanUrdu: Farishtey aur rooh(Jibrael) us mein apne Rubb ke izn(permission) se har hukm le kar utarte hai

verses.saheeh: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
verses.khattab: It is all peace until the break of dawn
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It is peaceful (salāmun hiya: a predicate preceding the subject) until the rising of the dawn (read matla‘ or matli‘), until the time it rises: it is peaceful because of the numerous salutations [of peace] (salām) spoken in it by the angels, who, every time they come across a believing man or believing woman, bid him peace.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh raat sarasar salamati hai tulu e fajr tak
